jobs.list.title: List jobs
jobs.list.description: List public job postings via GET /v0/postings/{site}.

opportunities.list.title: List opportunities
opportunities.list.description: List candidate opportunities via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities. Optional limit, offset, email, tag, stageId, postingId, and archived filters.

opportunities.get.title: Get opportunity
opportunities.get.description: Fetch a single opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}.

opportunities.interviews.list.title: List opportunity interviews
opportunities.interviews.list.description: List interviews for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/interviews. Optional limit and offset.

opportunities.feedback.list.title: List opportunity feedback
opportunities.feedback.list.description: List feedback forms for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/feedback. Optional limit and offset.

stages.list.title: List stages
stages.list.description: List pipeline stages via authenticated GET /v1/stages. Optional limit and offset.

users.list.title: List users
users.list.description: List account users via authenticated GET /v1/users. Optional limit, offset, email, and accessRole filters.

opportunities.update_stage.title: Update opportunity stage
opportunities.update_stage.description: Move an opportunity to another pipeline stage via authenticated PUT /v1/opportunities/{id}/stage. Connector input stageId maps to Lever body field stage (Stage UID per official docs). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

stageId.description: Destination stage UID; sent as Lever request body field stage.

opportunities.archive.title: Archive opportunity
opportunities.archive.description: Archive (or unarchive) an opportunity via authenticated PUT /v1/opportunities/{id}/archived. Body field reason is the archive reason UID; null unarchives. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

reason.description: Archive reason UID; null unarchives an already-archived opportunity.

cleanInterviews.description: Remove pending interviews when archiving (Lever default false).

requisitionId.description: Optional requisition UID when archiving as Hired.

archive_reasons.list.title: List archive reasons
archive_reasons.list.description: List account archive reasons via authenticated GET /v1/archive_reasons. Optional type filter (hired | non-hired), limit, and offset.

type.description: Optional filter for archive reason type.

offset.description: Opaque pagination offset token from a prior next field.

opportunities.update.title: Update opportunity
opportunities.update.description: Update an opportunity contact via authenticated PUT /v1/opportunities/{id}. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via opportunities.get.

emails.description: Email addresses to set on the contact.

tags.description: Tags to set on the opportunity.

opportunity.description: Normalized opportunity after EffectPolicy Reconcile via opportunities.get.

candidates.get.title: Get candidate
candidates.get.description: Fetch a Lever opportunity as a candidate via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}. Distinct from opportunities.get: returns a candidate-shaped record.

interviews.list.title: List interviews
interviews.list.description: List interviews for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/interviews. Requires opportunityId. Optional limit and offset.

interviews.get.title: Get interview
interviews.get.description: Fetch a single interview via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/interviews/{interviewId}.

offers.list.title: List offers
offers.list.description: List offers for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/offers. Requires opportunityId.

offers.get.title: Get offer
offers.get.description: Fetch a single offer via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/offers/{offerId}.

postings.list.title: List postings
postings.list.description: List authenticated job postings via GET /v1/postings. Distinct from public jobs.list. Optional state, limit, and offset filters.

postings.get.title: Get posting
postings.get.description: Fetch a single authenticated posting via GET /v1/postings/{id}. Distinct from public jobs.list.

notes.list.title: List notes
notes.list.description: List notes for an opportunity via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/notes. Requires opportunityId.

users.get.title: Get user
users.get.description: Fetch a single user via authenticated GET /v1/users/{id}.

requisitions.list.title: List requisitions
requisitions.list.description: List requisitions via authenticated GET /v1/requisitions. Optional limit and offset.

feedback.get.title: Get feedback
feedback.get.description: Fetch a single feedback form via authenticated GET /v1/opportunities/{id}/feedback/{feedbackId}.

perform_as.description: User UID to perform this action on behalf of.
